notes.title: Check out the new cyberpunk boomer shooter!
notes.notes:
Guys and gals, a new game from our publisher is here!

Beyond Sunset a cyberpunk pixel carnage by Vaporware. The game, inspired by Doom and Deus Ex, masterfully mixes frantic combat with strong RPG elements. There’s shooting, there’s puzzles, there’s swinging your katana around and a lot of immersing story to discover!

[previewyoutube=JZJ55-Il094;full][/previewyoutube]

Beyond Sunset is now out in Early Access with a 10% release discount. And if you like the genre, the release is accompanied by the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/moviegamessa/sale/RetroShooterSale]Ultimate Retro Shooter Sale[/url], where you can find more great games like this one! Bundles too.

Give it a look!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1665260/Beyond_Sunset/

notes.title: Holy cow! Get on the road with Alaskan Road Truckers!
A cyberpunk retro shooter Beyond Sunset coming soon in Early access
notes.notes:
News incoming! Our publisher, Movie Games, will soon be releasing a very cool boomer shooter in Early Access!

[previewyoutube=P-Jdzo3I-sc;full][/previewyoutube]

Beyond Sunset is a cyberpunk first-person shooter with a rich story and RPG elements. You are Lucy, an enhanced street samurai searching for lost memories. Fight in large, open, interactive levels overtaken by yakuza, zombies, robots and bosses!

Beyond Sunset is coming on 8 November. Wishlist it now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1665260/Beyond_Sunset/
